name: @todocloud/pwa
//build: Three steps, in order. (1) tsc emits the modules (see tsconfig.build.json). (2) public/ is this app's own shell: index.html, sw.js, manifest.webmanifest and connect.css, all of which differ from the local viewer's on purpose. (3) the viewer's assets are copied out of packages/cli/assets, which is the ONE copy of them: app.js, app.css and the three icons are byte-identical in both front ends, packages/cli/src/web/web.ts reads that directory from disk and scripts/build-sea.mjs stages it into the executable, so it stays where those two expect it and this build copies from it rather than holding a fork. The list is spelled out rather than globbed because cli/assets also holds an index.html, an sw.js and a manifest.webmanifest, and copying those over step 2 is exactly the mistake to make impossible.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R public/. dist/ && cp ../cli/assets/app.js ../cli/assets/app.css ../cli/assets/icon-192.png ../cli/assets/icon-512.png ../cli/assets/apple-touch-icon.png dist/
